raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Absolute cantilever dimensions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The attached image shows a 2:1 rectangle, but dimensional side lengths are not reported for this case.",
      "readings": [
        "Lx = 2, Ly = 1",
        "Lx = 60, Ly = 30, with unit square elements"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.1, Eq. (1), defines domain dimensions without assigning this case values. Table 5 identifies the matching standard cantilever as 60 × 30 elements. Attached cantilever_basic GT/schedule image."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Exact right-edge loaded node",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The topology terminates around right-edge midheight without a load marker. The actual cantilever_basic prompt is omitted; the explicit mid-right description belongs to an illustrative prompt containing a hole.",
      "readings": [
        "Right-edge midpoint: (Lx, 15 Ly/30)",
        "Adjacent node below the midpoint: (Lx, 14 Ly/30)",
        "Adjacent node above the midpoint: (Lx, 16 Ly/30)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.1, Algorithm 2, specifies only a cantilever tip load. Sec. 4.1 gives an illustrative mid-right load description. Sec. 5.1, Table 3, omits coordinates; the attached topology has no boundary-condition symbols."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Tip-force magnitude",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No force magnitude is assigned explicitly to cantilever_basic.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit resultant force, |F| = 1",
        "Resultant force |F| = 10 in the same force units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 5.1, Table 3, reports compliance without this case's force specification. The Fy = -1 expression in Sec. 4.1 is part of an illustrative hole-case description."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The solid material's Young's modulus and its normalization are not stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalized solid modulus E = 1",
        "Dimensional solid modulus E = 210 GPa with consistent force and length units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.3, Eq. (5), introduces the stiffness matrix and references SIMP interpolation but supplies no solid Young's modulus; Tables 3 and 5 provide no material values."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson's ratio is supplied for the isotropic elastic material.",
      "readings": [
        "nu = 0.30",
        "nu = 0.25"
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.3 and Eq. (5) do not specify Poisson's ratio; Sec. 4.1 and Table 3 contain no corresponding material specification."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The paper does not identify whether the two-dimensional cantilever uses plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4.1 identifies two-dimensional benchmarks; Sec. 3.3, Eq. (5), leaves the constitutive matrix unspecified."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No uniform thickness or explicit per-unit-thickness convention is given.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness, t = 1",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1 in the same length units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.3, Eq. (5), and the two-dimensional benchmark description in Sec. 4.1 do not state thickness; Table 3 reports compliance without dimensional units."
    }
  ]
}
